Punctual afternoon a helpful note for everyone using the desk
Please read this before you travel

Travel updates for pet and animal bookings

Travelers need to check their animal papers, carrier fit, and cabin rules before heading to the airport. Aurelia Skyways wants each trip to stay smooth, safe, and respectful for everyone at the desk and on board.

A safety coordinator reviews common risks and helps spot problems before departure. Please bring clear details about your companion animal, keep handling calm, and tell the desk right away if anything changes. <<FACT F077>> For rabbit bookings, the fee note will be given at the desk, along with the rest of the booking steps and any required checks.

If you are preparing with a pet like Coco, keep documents handy and arrive ready to speak plainly with the team. Prompt updates make it easier to sort out concerns, and respectful communication helps the whole process move faster.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you travel.
